text:
Type: drum shade table lamp
Use: ambient light on a side table, a console or a bedside table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, classic
Materials: white textured woven fabric shade, nickel-plated steel stem with height adjuster, square metal base
Colors: white, brushed silver
Shape: large cylindrical drum shade on a slender telescopic stem, small square base on little feet, tall and balanced, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, soft, tidy, homely
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, light wood, white walls; Scandinavian, contemporary or classic living rooms

product.name: ALNG
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 400 lumen globe opal white. View more product information The height is adjustable to suit your lighting needs.
